packageRules.description: Hold Python below 3.15 until runtime dependencies (e.g. pyyaml) ship 3.15 wheels; move .python-version and the Dockerfile uv/python base image together
apache-airflow-client 3.x targets only the Airflow 3 REST API (/api/v2); 2.x is kept while the operator supports Airflow 2 (/api/v1). Lift when Airflow 2 support is dropped.
